license_required.quote: license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

issuing_authority.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board," shall, in addition to the examinations provided for in chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes, hold meetings for the examination of all applicants under this chapter for a license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

name.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners

type.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board," shall, in addition to the examinations provided for in chapter 9 of Title 45

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Consumer Affairs, Department of Law and Public Safety
umbrella_agency.quote: professional and occupational licensing board within the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (D.P.M.) degree from an approved American school or college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: He has received a doctorate degree in podiatric medicine

accrediting_body.quote: in a legally incorporated American school or college of podiatric medicine, requiring personal attendance, in good standing in the opinion of said board

required.quote: Thereafter he has served a residency in a duly licensed clinic, hospital, or institution, approved by the board, for 1 full year devoted to the practice of podiatric medicine in all its branches

duration.quote: for 1 full year devoted to the practice of podiatric medicine in all its branches

kind.quote: served a residency in a duly licensed clinic, hospital, or institution, approved by the board, for 1 full year devoted to the practice of podiatric medicine in all its branches

exams.name: State Board of Medical Examiners examination for podiatric medicine
exams.quote: hold meetings for the examination of all applicants under this chapter for a license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

interval_years.quote: Every licensed podiatrist shall procure every two years from the executive director of the board, on or before November 1, a biennial certificate of registration

available.quote: a lawfully qualified podiatrist residing in another State from meeting registered podiatrists of this State in consultation, or any legally qualified podiatrist of another State from taking charge of the practice of a legally qualified podiatrist of this State temporarily on written permission of the board

requirements.value: Out-of-state podiatrist may take charge of resident's practice temporarily with written permission of board for up to 3 months upon payment of $10 fee, extendable for additional 6 months with additional $10 fee
requirements.quote: any legally qualified podiatrist of another State from taking charge of the practice of a legally qualified podiatrist of this State temporarily on written permission of the board during the latter's absence therefrom and upon the latter's written request to the board for permission so to do. Such permission may be granted for a period of not more than 3 months upon payment of a fee of $10.00. The board, in its discretion and upon payment of an additional fee of $10.00, may extend such permission for a further period but not to exceed 6 months

exists.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board," shall, in addition to the examinations provided for in chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes, hold meetings for the examination of all applicants under this chapter for a license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

regulatory_model.quote: license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

credential_type.quote: license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

is_mandatory.quote: Every licensed podiatrist who continues the practice of podiatric medicine after having failed to secure a biennial certificate of registration at the time and in the manner required by this section shall be subject to a penalty

scope_protection.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prohibit a duly licensed physician from treating diseases or ailments of the feet or ankles

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained license through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence that damaged or endangered life, health, welfare, safety or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or engaged in acts constituting a crime with direct or substantial relationship to regulated activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to practice revoked or suspended by another state or authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapable for medical or other good cause of discharging functions consistent with public health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use likely to impair ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted unlicensed person to perform act requiring license or aided and abetted unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of medical malpractice liability insurance requirement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A podiatrist who is in violation of this section is subject to disciplinary action and civil penalties

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A podiatrist licensed pursuant to chapter 5 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes shall not use an employee to administer physical modalities to patients unless that employee is a health care provider licensed in this State

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: A podiatrist who maintains a professional practice in this State and has responsibility for patient care is required to be covered by malpractice liability insurance, or if such liability coverage is not available, by a letter of credit for at least the minimum amount required by the State Board of Medical Examiners

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this act shall prohibit the fitting, recommending or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports or other mechanical appliances by retail dealers or manufacturers, provided, however, that they shall not be made or fabricated from plaster casts or models or by any other means for specific individual persons except upon the prescription of a podiatrist or physician
